title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: We need deterministic per-prompt regression checks and tighter metric integration for the eval-harness CI to prevent latent quality regressions in prompt sets and model rollouts. This PR adds a new CI hook (ci/eval-per-prompt) that runs per-prompt metrics in parallel, publishes results to the eval-metrics service, and fails the job when regressions exceed configured thresholds. Summary of changes: 1) New CI hook script (scripts/ci/run_per_prompt_checks.sh) that orchestrates per-prompt runs and posts metrics. 2) Eval harness integration (eval_harness/ci_hooks/per_prompt_hook.py) to compute and summarize prompt-level metrics (accuracy, rouge, perplexity proxy, and custom quality score). 3) A lightweight thresholding config (eval_harness/configs/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml) with defaults and per-team overrides. 4) CI workflow update (.github/workflows/eval-ci.yaml) to add ci/eval-per-prompt and a short-circuit path for fast failures. 5) Metrics uploader client (infra/metrics/uploader.py) and a dry-run mode for local testing. Checklist: - [x] Implement per-prompt runner and aggregator - [x] Add metrics uploader and auth integration - [x] Add CI workflow and docstring/tests - [x] E2E tests in CI (small prompt subsets) - [x] Docs: add section to docs/eval-harness/ci.md Testing: Unit tests added for aggregator logic and threshold evaluation (tests/unit/test_per_prompt_aggregator.py). CI run initially failed due to a timeout in the metrics uploader integration; updated uploader to use chunked async uploads and retried. Rollout plan: Merge to main; the hook is opt-in via repository level config opt-in under eval_harness/configs/ci_enabled.yaml. Once team leads opt in, we will turn on enforcement organization-wide after two weeks of on-call monitoring. Related: ENG-2148 (per-prompt gating), ENG-2199 (eval metrics v2).

release_notes: Add opt-in per-prompt regression CI hook for eval-harness that publishes prompt-level metrics and can fail CI when regressions exceed configured thresholds. Disabled by default; teams must opt-in via eval_harness/configs/ci_enabled.yaml. Includes metrics uploader with retries and dry-run mode for local testing.
notes_for_oncall: Monitor eval_metrics_ingest_errors and per_prompt_failure_rate dashboards for two weeks post-rollout. Default thresholds are conservative; escalate to ENG-2148 owner if repeated false positives.
impact: Improves early detection of prompt-level regressions and ties eval results into the metrics pipeline for observability and alerting. Initial opt-in minimizes blast radius.
